description: This file defines the enum `AgentWorkspaceConfig` which contains static methods for retrieving and setting workspace configuration data within a nested dictionary structure, probably to manage agent configurations within an application.

methods.name: workspace(from root: [String: Any]) -> String?
methods.description: Retrieves the 'workspace' string value from a nested dictionary structure.

methods.name: setWorkspace(in root: inout [String: Any], workspace: String?)
methods.description: Sets or removes the 'workspace' string value in the nested dictionary, handling the hierarchy of 'agents' and 'defaults'.
